svg.title: 13 LogAlto exchange & exports
svg.text: The MEL platform complements LogAlto: approved P4FP results flow to SNV's corporate system, and every record can leave as CSV, Excel or PDF
Set up with SNV's LogAlto focal point at inception
Validated records only unless you choose otherwise
Fallback when the API is unavailable
Automatic at 02:00 · encrypted · SNV admin can download
Restore last tested 02 Sep 2026 · 30 days kept
